name: Bib Kreyòl Ayisyen
title: Father’s Heart Bible — Bib Kreyòl Ayisyen (Haitian Creole)
sub: For Haitian families, Haitian pastors and evangelists, churches across Haiti, and Haitian churches in Florida

hookNative.text: Se konsa menm pou nou priye: ‘Papa nou ki nan syèl la, se pou non ou respekte tankou yon non ki sen,
son: Se konsa menm pou nou priye: ‘Papa nou ki nan syèl la, se pou non ou respekte tankou yon non ki sen,

hook.h2: You do not have to earn a place in these pages
hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
son: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
hook.note: When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word. Come, hear your Father’s voice.

translationStatement: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™.

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Haitian Creole, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Haitian Creole Bible (Bib Kreyòl Ayisyen), paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Sa a se premye Bib enprime ki montre ou kiyès k'ap pale. Pawòl Papa nou an BLE, pawòl Pitit la an WOUJ, pawòl Lespri a an VYOLÈT.

Pandan plis pase san ane, lèt wouj yo te montre ki kote Pitit la ap pale. Men Papa nou pale plis — nan Bib kreyòl sa a, 152,416 mo nan 5,609 vèsè. Jiska kounye a, pawòl li yo te enprime ak menm lank nwa ak lis jenealoji yo.
Koulè a di pawòl la se pou li; se pa yon mak sitasyon. Mo li pa janm di pa gen koulè; istwa a rete an nwa.

Lè disip li yo te mande l kijan pou yo priye, Pitit la ba yo yon Papa: “Papa nou ki nan syèl la, se pou non ou respekte tankou yon non ki sen” (Matye 6:9). Pa Lespri a nou rele: “Abba! Papa!” (Women 8:15).
Li pa lwen. Li pa desi ak ou. Li se Papa ou ki nan syèl la, e ou se pitit li renmen anpil. Si mo “papa” a pa konsole ou, Bib sa a se pou ou espesyalman.
Tout Bib la nan yon sèl volim — 66 liv, 1,189 chapit, 31,087 vèsè. Yon entwodiksyon pou chak liv, 1,361 nòt pou lektè a, ak yon paj dedikas pou ekri non moun ou ba li kado a.

Yon tradiksyon fidèl ki soti nan lang ebre, arameyen ak grèk orijinal yo; chak edisyon tradui soti nan Father's Heart Bible™. Fòma 6 x 9 pous, kouvèti mou ak kouvèti di, enprime an koulè. Yon kado, yon souvni, yon eritaj.
Pou chak fanmi ak legliz ayisyen — an Ayiti, nan Florid, New York, Boston, Monreyal ak tout dyaspora a.
Resevwa Papa ou. Tande vwa li. Kè li pou ou.

faq.q: Is the Haitian Creole edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Haitian Creole, 912 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Haitian Creole edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Haitian Creole edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Haitian Creole text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Haitian Creole Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/ht.
